direction: About 14 s. A wide closing still. Dai walks the chain forward to the next hedge while the surveyor stays at the table. Beyond them, a farmhouse roof and yard sit among the fields on the hill. A slow pull-back. Captions only.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 wide shot, inland Llandough hillside c. 1786. A big man in a waistcoat drags a surveyor's chain across a hedged field toward the next hedge-bank. A spectacled man in a dark frock coat stands at a plane-table in the foreground. Further up the hill stand a stone farmhouse with a slate roof and a farmyard among small fields, with oak woods and a distant river marsh below. Overcast late-morning light. No text, no heraldry, no coast.

captions.text: 1667: Williams family occupancy begins, as Mary Buckler later recounted. An earlier written source is awaited (CH-0003).
Looking ahead to 1824: David Stewart's survey of the Bute estates, plan 19, names the holding 'Cedfin or Tŷ Mawr', the oldest record found so far that names the house (EV-0211).
